turns.responseText:
ADMET Toxicity Screening — BCR-ABL1 Drug Candidates — Predicts cardiac safety, hepatotoxicity risk, and CNS penetration for 5 kinase inhibitors from SMILES input.

Input: 5 SMILES strings — Imatinib, Dasatinib, Nilotinib, Asciminib, and Terfenadine (positive hERG control reference)
Key steps:

predict_admet_properties ingests all 5 SMILES → computes 6 endpoints per compound: hERG cardiac IC₅₀, DILI hepatotoxicity score, Caco-2 permeability, BBB penetration, aqueous solubility, Ames mutagenicity
Endpoint results aggregated → admet_results.csv + risk_summary.json with per-compound safety flags


Expected output: admet_results.csv (full 6-endpoint table across all 5 compounds) + risk_summary.json (binary risk flags and confidence scores per compound) — Terfenadine will serve as a hERG-positive benchmark to validate model sensitivity

Decision gate: Flag any compound with predicted hERG IC₅₀ < 1 μM as a cardiac liability; DILI score > 0.5 triggers hepatotoxicity review; BBB penetration ratio > 0.1 indicates CNS exposure risk.
Required inputs

Input data files (e.g., structures/SMILES, assay data, or concentration-time table)
Basic study metadata (condition, units, and endpoint definitions)
